@graph.name: Gilt-head bream
@graph.description: A member of the seabream family, highly common in the Balearic Islands. Recognizable by the golden stripe between its eyes and its strong jaw adapted for crushing shells.

additionalProperty.name: Diet
additionalProperty.value: Molluscs, bivalve crustaceans, and small fish

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Mixed sandy, rocky sea beds and Posidonia oceanica meadows

@graph.name: Dolphin fish
@graph.description: Very fast and voracious pelagic fish, recognizable by its bright blue-green and yellow coloration that fades quickly upon death.

additionalProperty.name: Diet
additionalProperty.value: Small pelagic fish (sardines, anchovies), squids, and crustaceans

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Open waters, often under floating objects (fish aggregating devices or capcers)

@graph.name: Dusky grouper
@graph.description: Large serranid fish, emblematic of Balearic rocky sea beds. It is territorial, protogynous hermaphrodite, and exhibits very slow growth.

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Caves, crevices, and deep rocky sea beds

additionalProperty.name: Closed season / Restriction
additionalProperty.value: Maximum 1 specimen per license per day

additionalProperty.name: Fishing methods
additionalProperty.value: Bottom fishing with live bait, deep trolling, regulated spearfishing

additionalProperty.name: Fishing zone
additionalProperty.value: Rocky beds, caves, between 10 and 80 m

@graph.name: Red scorpionfish
@graph.description: Reddish-colored fish with venomous spines in its dorsal fins. It camouflages perfectly with the rocky sea beds, waiting silently for prey.

additionalProperty.name: Diet
additionalProperty.value: Crustaceans, molluscs, and small rock fish

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Rocky sea beds, coralligenous zones, and Posidonia meadows

additionalProperty.name: Fishing methods
additionalProperty.value: Bottom fishing with natural bait (squid, small fish), spinning with jigs

@graph.name: White seabream
@graph.description: Silver-colored fish with dark vertical bands. Highly sought after by coastal anglers, especially on rough sea days or 'swell wave' days.

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Surf zones, cliffs, and shallow rocky sea beds

additionalProperty.name: Fishing methods
additionalProperty.value: Bottom fishing with natural bait (worms, shrimp), float fishing

@graph.name: Painted comber
@graph.description: Small serranid with bright blue colors and vertical stripes. Inhabits shallow rocky beds and is highly combative for its size.

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Shallow rocky sea beds and Posidonia meadows

additionalProperty.name: Fishing methods
additionalProperty.value: Light spinning, bottom fishing with small hooks

@graph.name: Common dentex
@graph.description: Large seabream highly valued for its gastronomic quality and fierce fight. Inhabits rocky sea beds and Posidonia meadows.

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Rocky and mixed sea beds, between 15 and 50 m

additionalProperty.name: Fishing methods
additionalProperty.value: Bottom trolling, spinning with lures, deep bottom fishing with live bait

additionalProperty.name: Fishing zone
additionalProperty.value: Rocky beds, cliffs, strong current zones

@graph.name: Saddled seabream
@graph.description: Silver-colored fish with a characteristic black spot surrounded by a white ring on the tail. Very common in shallow waters and forms large schools.

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Shallow rocky zones, harbors, Posidonia meadows

additionalProperty.name: Fishing methods
additionalProperty.value: Float fishing, bottom fishing with natural bait (bread, shrimp)

@graph.name: Dreamfish
@graph.description: Herbivorous fish with horizontal yellow/golden stripes. Feeds almost exclusively on marine algae and forms massive schools in Posidonia meadows.

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Posidonia meadows, shallow rocky sea beds

additionalProperty.name: Fishing methods
additionalProperty.value: Float fishing, bottom fishing with green algae or bread

additionalProperty.name: Fishing zone
additionalProperty.value: Posidonia meadows, shallow rocky beds with vegetation

additionalProperty.name: Culinary quality
additionalProperty.value: Low (soft flesh with strong herbal taste)

@graph.name: Atlantic bonito
@graph.description: Medium-sized pelagic fish from the mackerel family. Highly migratory and voracious, offering spectacular active fights for sports fishers.

additionalProperty.name: Preferred habitat
additionalProperty.value: Open sea, pelagic zone, coastal areas in summer

additionalProperty.name: Fishing methods
additionalProperty.value: Spinning with hard lures, light trolling, jigging

additionalProperty.name: Fishing zone
additionalProperty.value: Open sea, cliff edges, cape heads

@graph.name: Sea bass (Llobarro)
@graph.description: Active predator of sandy bottoms and Posidonia meadows, also called llobarro in the Balearic Islands. Fish of great gastronomic and sporting value.

additionalProperty.name: Hábitat preferido
additionalProperty.value: Sandy bottoms, Posidonia meadows, mouths and surf zones

additionalProperty.name: Cuota máxima
additionalProperty.value: No specific limit (within the quota of 5 kg/day)

additionalProperty.name: Métodos de pesca
additionalProperty.value: Night surfcasting, spinning, buoy fishing with live bait

@graph.name: Corvallo (Escorball)
@graph.description: Bottom species with the ability to produce sounds with its swim bladder. Highly appreciated by underwater and bottom fishermen for its top quality meat.

additionalProperty.name: Dieta
additionalProperty.value: Crustaceans, mollusks, polychaete worms and small fish

additionalProperty.name: Estacionalidad
additionalProperty.value: All year round (most active at night)

additionalProperty.name: Hábitat preferido
additionalProperty.value: Rocky bottoms with cracks, coralline, between 5 and 50 meters

additionalProperty.name: Métodos de pesca
additionalProperty.value: Deep night fishing with natural bait, underwater fishing

@graph.name: Amberjack (Cirviola / Verderol juvenile)
@graph.description: One of the most powerful pelagic predators in the Mediterranean. The juveniles, known as 'verderols', form schools in summer and are highly sought after by sport fishermen.

additionalProperty.name: Dieta
additionalProperty.value: Pelagic fish (sardine, bogue, horse mackerel), cephalopods

additionalProperty.name: Hábitat preferido
additionalProperty.value: Pelagic waters, near cliffs and seamounts

additionalProperty.name: Veda/Restricción
additionalProperty.value: Juveniles (verderols <30 cm) prohibited from July 1 to September 15

additionalProperty.name: Métodos de pesca
additionalProperty.value: Trolling, heavy jigging, live bait fishing, shore spinning

additionalProperty.name: Zona de pesca
additionalProperty.value: Open sea, near rocky bottoms and cliffs

@graph.name: Bluefin Tuna (Tonyina)
@graph.description: The largest pelagic predator in the Mediterranean. Recreational bluefin tuna fishing is heavily regulated by quotas and requires special permits.

additionalProperty.name: Dieta
additionalProperty.value: Pelagic fish of all sizes, cephalopods

additionalProperty.name: Estacionalidad
additionalProperty.value: June to September (migratory passage through the Mediterranean)

additionalProperty.name: Veda/Restricción
additionalProperty.value: Requires specific recreational fishing quota for bluefin tuna (MAPAMA). Very limited quotas.

additionalProperty.name: Métodos de pesca
additionalProperty.value: Deep sea trolling, live bait fishing, deep jigging

@graph.name: Mackerel (Verat)
@graph.description: Pelagic fish of the scombridae family, fast and gregarious. It forms large schools in spring and summer, being very accessible for fishing from shore and boat.

additionalProperty.name: Hábitat preferido
additionalProperty.value: Pelagic surface waters, coasts and bays

additionalProperty.name: Métodos de pesca
additionalProperty.value: Light spinning with metal lures, chambel, live bait

additionalProperty.name: Zona de pesca
additionalProperty.value: Coast, dikes, open sea near the surface
